create_HabitatSim: create a HabitatSim simulator instance from a SimulatorConfig to run embodied AI simulation
call_reset: reset the HabitatSim simulator and return initial sensor observations for the current episode
call_step: step the HabitatSim simulator with an action and return updated sensor observations
call_geodesic_distance: compute the geodesic distance between two positions in the HabitatSim simulator scene
call_semantic_annotations: retrieve the semantic scene hierarchy with levels, regions, and objects from the simulator
